response.explanation: At line 3, src/presentation/server.ts imports HireStockRepository from the persistence layer. At line 15 it creates the repository with `new HireStockRepository()` and passes it into the RinkService constructor (lines 12-28). The file does the same for the other persistence classes it imports on lines 1-5 (SessionRepository, BookingRepository, PuckPayClient and DropTextClient). The file is the process entry point and works as the app's composition root: it builds the object graph, starts the expiry timer (line 30) and starts the HTTP app (line 32). It does not call the repository's data-access methods itself. Even so, FF-S03 defines the layer order as presentation -> business -> persistence, so this is a direct import from presentation into persistence that skips the business layer, and the rule flags it. The graph can't tell this wiring apart from a real data-access shortcut. That difference matters for the fix, but the verdict stays the same.
